svg.text: Real NWS responses, 12:39 to 13:39 UTC on 28 October: all 8 kept the same hours; only timestamps and headers changed
Hourly temperature forecast over the contract day, 00:00 to 23:59 local. Black: latest content. Grey: earlier content. Dots: each response; grey ones were rejected as refreshes.
4 responses collected. Refreshes rejected: 3. Content revisions: 0.
Los Angeles, settles on KLAX, high > 71 °F

Simulated: the controller dies at 23:49:20 ET and a new process restarts at 00:10
The broker is a separate simulated process that keeps its state. Nothing here touched a real account. World A shown; B differs after 23:50.

The executions reply holds every fill already in the journal,
so absence is evidence. i-105 is found by orderId with its
orderRef; fills and the correction are booked once; i-106 is
closed as never received. Los Angeles resumes; Miami does not.
Fills the journal saw at 23:45 and 23:49 are missing from
the reply: no absence proves anything. Our order filled, or
another strategy bought (-4 unattributed). Los Angeles is
suspended, our working order cancelled, and the operator
asked for the Trade Log over the window it cannot see.
